two_members.reason: trailing bytes after the compressed TLS response

defect_found.consequence: a peer could append arbitrary data after a member, including a second member, and the client would return a body that did not describe the whole response
defect_found.description: the gzip/deflate decoder checked decoder.eof but ignored decoder.unused_data, so a body whose compressed stream ended early still decoded and any remaining bytes were silently dropped

fix: unused_data must be empty after the single member this path decodes; otherwise the response is refused
notable: the bomb is refused by the existing decoded-size bound, which is why no new limit was needed
